The classic mall brand dropped a second collaboration with Victoria Beckham today, featuring 37 expensive-looking closet staples starting at just $28.

Beckham told Harper’s Bazaar that the latest designs allowed her to “reimagine the effortless wardrobe staples that become part of everyday life, while introducing an element of the unexpected.”

While the first drop — which flew off the shelves this spring — focused largely on warmer weather staples, the new lineup includes plenty of standout knitwear and outerwear. Scroll on to shop some of our favorites, before they’re gone for good.

Given one of Beckham’s knit designs already sold out, we predict this versatile turtleneck might be next. In addition to gray, it’s also still available in cream, maroon, dark green and black.

Bundling up needn’t mean sacrificing style. The former Spice Girl brought her signature style sense to this satin bomber jacket. (It comes in Essex green, in addition to this gorgeous bordeaux hue.)

For something a little warmer, take on the fall chill in this wind-resistant, crinkle twill parka.

No one does basics quite like Beckham. Case in point? This elevated tuxedo shirt, which is already selling out in some sizes.

Whether your winter calendar includes holiday parties or simply several in-office days, this draped maxi dress delivers the quiet luxury look for less.

No Gap collection would be complete without denim options, like these baggy, on-trend jeans.

Don’t want to spend tons of cash on cashmere? Try this cozy, Beckham-approved option for under $150 instead.

Utility pants were among the first to sell out after the first launch, so this belted design isn’t one to wait on.

Leave it to Victoria Beckham to make a white tee look elevated. Her take on the classic wardrobe staple is made from 100% organic cotton — and includes a subtle Gap x Victoria Beckham logo on the back.

Even Posh Spice appreciates a good sweatshirt on occasion.

This article was written by Hannah Southwick, Commerce Associate Editor for Page Six. Hannah spies deals on actually affordable celebrity-worn styles, puts celebrities’ brands to the test and finds the beauty products that keep stars red carpet-ready. She consults stylists and industry pros — including celebs themselves — for firsthand product recommendations, trend predictions and more. In addition to writing for Page Six since 2020, her work has been featured in USA Today and Parade.

پوشش‌های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. این مارک تجاری کلاسیک امروز دومین همکاری خود را با ویکتوریا بکهام لغو کرد که شامل 37 قطعه اصلی کمد گران‌قیمت با قیمت اولیه فقط 28 دلار بود. در حالی که اولین قطره - که در بهار امسال از قفسه‌ها خارج شد - عمدتاً بر روی آب و هوای گرم‌تر متمرکز بود، ترکیب جدید شامل مقدار زیادی لباس بافتنی و لباس‌های بیرونی برجسته است. برای خرید برخی از موارد دلخواه ما، قبل از اینکه برای همیشه از بین بروند، بروید. با توجه به اینکه یکی از طرح‌های بافتنی بکهام قبلاً فروخته شده است، پیش‌بینی می‌کنیم که این یقه‌پوش چندمنظوره ممکن است بعدی باشد. علاوه بر خاکستری، همچنان در رنگ های کرم، قهوه ای، سبز تیره و مشکی نیز موجود است. در کنار هم قرار گرفتن به معنای فدا کردن سبک نیست. Spice Girl سابق حس استایل خود را به این ژاکت بمب افکن ساتن آورده است. (علاوه بر این رنگ زیبای بوردو، به رنگ سبز اسکس می آید.)
برای چیزی گرم‌تر، سرمای پاییزی را در این پارک پارچه‌ای چروکیده و مقاوم در برابر باد تحمل کنید. هیچ‌کس مانند بکهام اصول اولیه را انجام نمی‌دهد. مورد در نقطه؟ این پیراهن تاکسیدو بلند که در حال حاضر در برخی از اندازه ها به فروش می رسد. فرقی نمی‌کند تقویم زمستانی شما شامل مهمانی‌های تعطیلات باشد یا صرفاً چندین روز در دفتر، این لباس ماکسی روکش‌دار ظاهری لوکس و آرام را برای کمتر به ارمغان می‌آورد. مجموعه No Gap بدون گزینه‌های جین، مانند این لباس‌های گشاد و گشاد، کامل نخواهد بود.

The Big Apple’s private sector lost more than 30,000 jobs in the last two months alone — in what the city comptroller called a “concerning” downward trend.

Private-sector employment dropped by 23,000 in September after losing 7,400 jobs in August — with gigs in finance and tourism leading the private sector in declines, according to a new report by City Comptroller Mark Levine’s office.

“Despite a relatively strong tourism season, Leisure & Hospitality employment fell 7,700 in September alone and is down 17,000 jobs over the past year,” Levine wrote, calling the figures “concerning” across the board.

The finance sector, one of the state’s biggest tax revenue drivers, shrank by nearly 6,000 positions in September as well.

Overall, the city’s private sector has lost 32,000 positions over the past year, according to the report released Thursday.

“After picking up some steam earlier this year, the job market has hit a wall, with private sector employment decelerating nationally and dropping sharply locally,” Levine wrote.

“Meanwhile, national GDP is estimated to have grown by roughly 3% this past quarter,” he continued. “The ‘K-Shaped’ economy gripping the country is squeezing New York City just as tightly.”

He noted the 0.6% inflation jump in September nationally was the largest since May, “with New York City now up 4.5% year-to-year, as residents face a high cost of living compounded by rising energy costs.”

“Rents are now over 5% higher than this time last year, and energy prices are up over 21% since then as well,” Levine said.

But the fiscal watchdog said the city’s outlook wasn’t completely dire, with the unemployment rate holding steady at 4.8% and “red-hot rental markets” in office and residential properties pointing to continued demand for folks to move to and stay in five boroughs.

The private sector job losses, though, come ahead of the expected debate in Albany about hiking taxes on businesses to cover the impending massive budget deficits in New York City and other municipalities around the state.

Gov. Kathy Hochul has vowed on the campaign trail not to raise taxes for corporations.

Still, many insiders expect some sort of new revenue raiser for the state to be put forward as Mayor Zohran Mamdani pushes his “tax the rich” agenda.

The San Francisco 49ers fan base has earned the “Faithful” moniker for a reason.

One such fan made his faith in the franchise permanent, and did so in a place that is raising eyebrows.

A video of a male 49ers fan rocking a massive lower back tattoo while at the pool has gone viral on social media. The initial video, which was posted on Thursday afternoon, has tallied over 800,000 views, and countless other accounts have since reposted it.

“A 49ers tramp stamp is insane,” the initial post was captioned.

The fan also had a Tottenham Hotspur logo on his upper back, which is an English Premier League team. But the positioning of that tattoo is a lot less conspicuous then the 49ers one below it.

Many social media accounts are having a field day with the tattoo. The Barstool Sports’ X account reposted the video and wrote, “Do you really love your team if you don’t have a tramp stamp of their logo?”

“This counts as the Niners first loss of the season btw,” another X user added in a comment.

“Tell me you finished last in a fantasy football league without actually telling me you finished last in a fantasy football league,” added another, suggesting this might have been a diabolical fantasy football punishment.

At least San Francisco is somewhat justifying the tattoo through their 6-0 start to the season.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

Indiana Fever founding president and general manager Kelly Krauskopf is stepping down after nearly three decades with Pacers Sports & Entertainment, the company announced Friday.

Krauskopf joined PS&E in 1999, a year before the Fever’s inaugural season in 2000.

During her time with the Fever, she helped lead the expansion franchise to three trips to the WNBA Finals and the 2012 championship.

Krauskopf also worked with the Pacers as their assistant general manager from 2018-24, becoming the first woman to hold an executive basketball management role in the NBA’s history, before returning to the Fever as their president of basketball and business operations.

Before joining PS&E, Krauskopf was the WNBA’s first director of basketball operations, helping establish the foundation of the league before its launch in 1997.

Krauskopf’s resignation comes as the Fever organization is under fire for online and in-arena harassment of opposing teams and their players, creating what The Athletic dubbed “a simmering disquiet among players” and forcing the WNBA to address how they monitor what players face at Gainbridge Fieldhouse.

Many players have reportedly shared their sense of “diminished sense of security” when playing in Indianapolis.

Even their own players have dealt with issues with fans.

Fever star Kelsey Mitchell alluded to these issues in her exit interview after the Fever lost in the first round of the 2026 playoffs to the Aces.

“Showing up every day to compete for fans that may or may not like you is hard,” Mitchell said.

“I think this organization is unbelievable, man, but I think that when it comes to, like, really trying to be yourself, it hasn’t always been easy.”

Krauskopf’s exit also comes as Fever superstar Caitlin Clark becomes eligible for an Exceptional Performance on Initial Contract (EPIC) extension, allowing a player to renegotiate what would have been the fourth year of a rookie deal to come to terms on a three-year extension.

They can then earn the maximum salary in their fourth year if they were named to an All-WNBA team or won a major award of their own.

The Fever have several unrestricted free agents heading into this offseason, including Mitchell, who’s coming off a career season.

That’s the way the cookie crumbles.

Dessert giant Crumbl is shuttering dozens of stores following a massive drop in sales — with seven locations in California disappearing so far in 2026.

The viral sweet treat chain, known for frosting-heavy, highly-photogenic offerings, has slammed the doors shut at a total of 57 locations around the country this year, according to a new report from RestaurantBusiness.

Crumbl’s Golden State closures include stores in Paso Robles, Pismo Beach, Hanford, Ladera Ranch, Mira Mesa, Cupertino, and Westlake Village, SFGATE reported. The chain also closed locations in Alabama, Florida and Kentucky.

The crumby news comes amid a significant sales slump for the once-ubiquitous cookie brand. Traffic at the chain’s stores were down 32% year-over-year in August, RestaurantBusiness reported. Overall sales were 70% lower in August than two years ago.

At least 55 franchises are currently listed for sale, according to the report.

Founded in 2017 by cousins Sawyer Hemsley and Jason McGowan, Crumbl opened its first location in Utah and exploded in popularity during the pandemic, when delivery in the company’s signature pink boxes became a must-have for younger consumers.

A 2022 report by Dataessential found that Crumbl was the fastest-growing dessert brand, and the fourth-fastest-growing food chain in the country.

At the time, the company sold nearly a million cookies every day.

Crumbl continued to grow from there. In 2023, Crumbl opened 295 stores in 2023, bringing its total to more than 1,000 locations nationwide by 2024. Last year, Bloomberg reported that the company had received a $500 million credit loan from two private equity firms.

Earlier this year, the company rolled out “dirty sodas”  — a popular caffeine-free, non-alcohollic soft drink in Utah in hopes of boosting sales, but the drinks sparked backlash due to their incredibly high calorie count.

In May, Helmsley and McGowan announced they planned to step down from their roles as chief executive officer and chief brand officer after they find replacements for their roles, though will still remain active as board members of the company.

“As we enter this next chapter, we’re excited to step deeper into our founder roles and help shape the long-term vision of the company we love so much,” the pair wrote in an Instagram announcement. “I believe now is the right time to bring in new leadership through an open search process.”

Crumbl now operates just 20 stores in all of California, according to its website. The California Post reached out to Crumbl for comment on its closures and sales.

The West Hollywood gay dad who assaulted a MAGA influencer on video will not face charges after completing a “pre-filing diversion” agreement with prosecutors, his attorney said Thursday.

David Vulin, 32, was caught on video hitting conservative streamer Ryley Niemi back in April, and police arrested him on suspicion of battery and vandalism.

Niemi had asked Vulin and his husband, who were out with their young child, if they had heard of “statistics coming out that gay men are much more likely to commit child molestation,” and asked if the two men had paid $50,000 to a woman to get pregnant.

Vulin signed the agreement with the Los Angeles County District Attorney’s office, which ensures he will not face criminal prosecution. It’s unclear what the terms of the agreement are.

The family said they were relieved by the ruling but disappointed that “the person who provoked this encounter with hate speech then filmed and monetized it, faces no consequences.”

“But we’re determined to turn this into something meaningful,” they said. “Anthony is working with state legislators on a bill to hold rage-bait creators accountable for the harm they cause.”

Niemi, who said David Vulin broke his camera as well, expressed shock at the ruling to the Los Angeles Times. He believed David should have been charged with felony assault.

“This wasn’t a normal battery. I walked away 500 feet,” Niemi said. “He hit me in the back of the head and gave me a concussion.”

He said he’s mulling filing a civil lawsuit against the couple.

The conservative influencer added that he asked similar questions to other people that day and no one reacted the same way the Vulins did. Niemi said he only asked the question because “they brought their baby out to the gay clubs at 9 p.m.”

He believes there’s a double standard at play here.

“If they said something to me about how being conservative is bad, and I punched them, I really don’t think I’d get off the hook for that,” he said.

جامعه ما در مورد ارتباط مردم از طریق گفتگوهای باز و متفکرانه است. ما می‌خواهیم خوانندگان ما نظرات خود را به اشتراک بگذارند و در فضایی امن تبادل نظر کنند. برای انجام این کار، مجموعه‌ای از قوانین ساده ایجاد کرده‌ایم که تجربه شما را بهبود می‌بخشد. به زبان ساده، آن را مدنی نگه دارید. اگر پست شما حاوی موارد زیر باشد، ممکن است/رد رد شود:
اگر متوجه شویم حساب‌های کاربر مسدود می‌شوند/ممکن است: بنابراین، چگونه می توانید یک کاربر قدرتمند باشید؟ از اینکه دستورالعمل های انجمن ما را خواندید متشکریم. فراموش نکنید، آزادی بیان، آزادی دسترسی نیست!

news.originalContent:
A further escalation would ‘create nothing but losers’, the French foreign minister warns after joint Istanbul meeting.

Foreign ministers from eight countries are cautioning the United States against further attacks on Iran after meeting in Turkiye to discuss the Strait of Hormuz and other regional developments.

Ministers from the United Kingdom, France and Germany, known as the E3, convened with counterparts from the R4 group of Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Egypt on Friday, along with Italy.

Speaking after the meeting in Istanbul, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said that none of the countries participating in the meeting approved of another military intervention or attack on Iran.

Such a move would only exacerbate tensions and further expand the conflict, he said, adding that diplomacy and dialogue were the only way to end the war.

A further escalation between Iran and the US “would create nothing but losers and would undoubtedly have very serious consequences for hydrocarbon prices,” French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot told reporters.

“And so the first thing this group of eight countries … will do is call on both sides to exercise the utmost restraint, because we cannot afford another escalation in the region,” he added.

Italy’s Antonio Tajani said the aim was to work for “de-escalation to guarantee freedom of navigation.”

“I do not believe the problem can be solved from a purely military standpoint,” he said, noting that “we must promote dialogue” in order to reopen Hormuz.

The group also discussed Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, escalating fighting in Yemen and prospects for ending the Russia-Ukraine war.

Reporting from Istanbul, Al Jazeera’s Sinem Koseoglu said the summit was a “first-of-its-kind” attempt to discuss the parameters of regional conflicts and possible solutions.

Although participating countries “all have different national interests, especially when it comes to the crisis in the Gulf”, the Turkish foreign minister “underlined that what is happening in the Gulf … is affecting the other parts of the world”, Koseoglu added.

The meeting at an Istanbul hotel came as Turkiye seeks to bolster its role in the region, including through the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, the trilateral pact launched with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia in August.

Turkiye has said that the pact is not aimed at any specific country and remains open to others joining, including Egypt.

Fidan told reporters the pact has “several advantages, particularly because it is informal and flexible and focuses specifically on the issues we face.”

“We are not aware of any other platform that brings together countries with such different geographical and political backgrounds,” he said, noting that Ankara “is well placed to play a constructive role in this process”.

Cairo has yet to decide whether to join the agreement. President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi recently said that Egypt would “carry out any measure to protect” Saudi Arabia.

The Iran-backed Houthis are fighting Yemen’s Saudi-backed internationally recognised government forces and have launched a series of deadly attacks on Saudi Arabia.
news.content:
وزیر امور خارجه فرانسه پس از نشست مشترک استانبول هشدار داد که تشدید تنش‌ها «چیزی جز بازنده‌ها ایجاد نمی‌کند». وزرای بریتانیا، فرانسه و آلمان موسوم به E3 روز جمعه با همتایان خود از گروه R4 ترکیه، عربستان سعودی، پاکستان و مصر به همراه ایتالیا تشکیل جلسه دادند. هاکان فیدان وزیر امور خارجه ترکیه پس از نشست در استانبول گفت که هیچ یک از کشورهای شرکت کننده در این نشست مداخله نظامی یا حمله دیگری به ایران را تایید نکردند. ژان نوئل بارو، وزیر امور خارجه فرانسه به خبرنگاران گفت، چنین اقدامی تنها تنش ها را تشدید می کند و مناقشه را بیشتر می کند، وی افزود که دیپلماسی و گفتگو تنها راه پایان دادن به جنگ است. تشدید بیشتر بین ایران و آمریکا "چیزی جز بازنده ایجاد نخواهد کرد و بدون شک عواقب بسیار جدی برای قیمت های هیدروکربن خواهد داشت." او افزود: «و بنابراین اولین کاری که این گروه متشکل از هشت کشور انجام خواهند داد این است که از هر دو طرف بخواهند حداکثر خویشتنداری را اعمال کنند، زیرا ما نمی توانیم تنش دیگری را در منطقه تحمل کنیم.» آنتونیو تاجانی از ایتالیا گفت که هدف تلاش برای «کاهش تنش برای تضمین آزادی دریانوردی» است.
وی با اشاره به اینکه ما باید گفت‌وگو را ترویج کنیم، گفت: من معتقد نیستم که این مشکل از نقطه نظر نظامی صرفا قابل حل باشد.

news.originalContent:
Photo by SAUL LOEB / AFP via Getty Images

Major U.S. banks moved to restrict third-party artificial intelligence agents from accessing customer accounts Thursday amid growing concerns over the security risks posed by automated financial tools.

Citi and Wells Fargo confirmed restrictions to the Daily Caller News Foundation, citing concerns about unauthorized access to customer accounts. The policies highlight a growing challenge for financial institutions as consumers turn to AI tools capable of accessing sensitive banking information and potentially conducting transactions on their behalf. (RELATED: Political Debanking Ran Rampant At America’s Biggest Banks, Federal Probe Alleges)

“To help safeguard customer accounts and information, we do not permit third-party AI agents or assistants to log into a customer’s account or transact directly within our digital banking platforms,” Citi spokeswoman Gabrielle Baum told the DCNF.

“Customers can, however, continue to authorize limited, read-only access to their account information with certain Citi-approved open banking providers,” Baum added.

Wells Fargo also confirmed it has taken steps to restrict unauthorized access.

“Wells Fargo has taken steps to block unauthorized agents from accessing customer accounts,” a company spokesperson told the DCNF.

You have to be retarded to give AI direct access to your bank accounts. The fact that this technology was invented 10 seconds ago and already so many people are willing to just hand their entire lives over to it and make themselves completely dependent on it and vulnerable to it is so unbelievably depressing but also not shocking.

Major financial institutions, including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo, are confronting security concerns involving outside AI agents accessing customer accounts, according to an Axios report Thursday. Some agents reportedly appeared to take actions beyond customers’ instructions, according to people familiar with the issue cited in the report.

However, an industry source familiar with the issue told the DCNF that the immediate concern is not AI agents independently infiltrating customer accounts, but customers voluntarily sharing their banking credentials with third-party AI tools.

The source said there is not yet evidence of agents being instructed to perform one task and independently carrying out another. Rather, the activity originates with customers granting access to their accounts, creating potential security risks that banks may struggle to distinguish from legitimate customer activity.

Although customers may authorize AI tools to access their accounts, financial institutions can still prohibit those tools from logging in or conducting transactions.

Unlike conventional chatbots, AI agents are designed to carry out tasks on behalf of users, potentially including reviewing financial information, making purchases or transferring money. Depending on the permissions granted, the technology could move beyond providing financial recommendations to taking actions involving customers’ funds.

Morgan Stanley has begun blocking outside AI agents from accessing its platforms, while JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citi have also restricted access, according to Axios. Banks have tightened restrictions partly over concerns that outside agents could expose customer information or initiate transactions without sufficient safeguards.

AI agents capable of comparing interest rates and moving deposits could eventually challenge traditional banking relationships by making it easier for customers to shift funds between institutions. Such technology could pressure banks’ profitability by helping customers move money out of low-interest accounts, the Financial Times reported in October.

news.originalContent:
Antiterrorism prosecutors investigating motive of attack that seriously wounded five, including a 12-year-old girl.

A gunman has killed one person ⁠⁠and wounded five others, including a 12-year-old girl, in a possible Islamophobic “terrorist crime” in the Paris suburbs, authorities said.

An unidentified 39-year-old male suspect was taken into custody shortly after the attacks in the towns of Trappes and nearby La Verriere outside the capital on Friday.

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said the suspect fired at a children’s playground, a fuel station and a medical centre, the Reuters news agency reported. Three of the victims, including the 12-year-old girl, suffered life-threatening injuries, he said.

Nunez said the attack lasted less than 15 minutes and that the gunman appeared to have used “a military-grade weapon, or at least an automatic weapon”. Prosecutors were treating it as a “terrorist crime” and investigating whether it was racially or religiously motivated, he said.

Trappes Mayor Ali Rabeh said the gunman “appeared to be firing at random and seemed intent on carrying out a massacre”.

“This was a terrorist attack with racist, likely Islamophobic, overtones,” he said.

Rabeh earlier said two of the victims were of African and North African origins.

French President Emmanuel Macron said national antiterrorism prosecutors had taken over the case.

“Our thoughts go out to the victims, their families, and all the residents of Yvelines. In this terrible ordeal, the Nation stands by their side,” Macron posted on X.

Separately, security was tightened ahead of protests that are expected across the country this weekend. Many of the demonstrations have been banned following burning and looting at protests last weekend.

Nunez said France would deploy 70,000 officers nationwide on Saturday, along with helicopters, armoured vehicles and water cannon. In addition, elite police units will help secure public buildings, such as city halls, in a “highly mobile” security operation, he said.

Protests last week caused chaos, with people setting fires, storming public buildings, smashing shop windows, looting and clashing with police, in France’s most violent unrest in years.

Far-right politicians say the government has not cracked down hard enough on protesters, while left-wing groups say the security around demonstrations violates rights.

Demonstrators plan to take to the streets again on Saturday to denounce the high cost of living. Students, members of the Confederation of Labour, a national trade union and activists from the “yellow vest” movement, whose demonstrations against social injustice shook France in 2018 and 2019, are all set to join.
news.content: دادستان های ضد تروریسم در حال بررسی انگیزه حمله ای هستند که پنج نفر از جمله یک دختر 12 ساله را به شدت مجروح کرد. مقامات گفتند که یک مرد مسلح در یک "جنایت تروریستی" احتمالی اسلام هراسی در حومه پاریس یک نفر را کشته و پنج نفر دیگر از جمله یک دختر 12 ساله را زخمی کرده است. یک مظنون مرد 39 ساله ناشناس، اندکی پس از حملات روز جمعه در شهرهای تراپ و مجاور لاوریر در خارج از پایتخت بازداشت شد. خبرگزاری رویترز گزارش داد، وزیر کشور، لوران نونز، گفت که مظنون به سمت زمین بازی کودکان، یک پمپ بنزین و یک مرکز پزشکی شلیک کرده است. وی گفت: سه تن از قربانیان از جمله یک دختر 12 ساله دچار جراحات شدید شده اند. نونز گفت که این حمله کمتر از 15 دقیقه به طول انجامید و به نظر می رسد که فرد مسلح از "یک سلاح درجه نظامی یا حداقل یک سلاح خودکار" استفاده کرده است. او گفت که دادستان ها با آن به عنوان یک "جنایت تروریستی" برخورد می کردند و بررسی می کردند که آیا این جنایت با انگیزه های نژادی یا مذهبی بوده است. علی رابه، شهردار تراپ، گفت که فرد مسلح "به نظر می رسید که به طور تصادفی شلیک می کرد و به نظر می رسید قصد انجام یک قتل عام را داشت". او گفت: «این یک حمله تروریستی با مضامین نژادپرستانه، احتمالاً اسلام‌هراسی بود.» رابه پیشتر گفت که دو تن از قربانیان اصالتاً آفریقایی و آفریقای شمالی بودند. امانوئل ماکرون، رئیس‌جمهور فرانسه گفت که دادستان‌های ضد تروریسم ملی این پرونده را بر عهده گرفته‌اند.

news.originalContent:
Democrats are framing the conflict as an affordability issue to criticise Republican candidates backed by Trump.

Detroit, Michigan – The first question in the United States Senate debate in Michigan between Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed and his Republican rival Mike Rogers was about the issue that appears to matter most to voters – the economy.

El-Sayed quickly drew a contrast between himself and Rogers, who is backed by US President Donald Trump. It was not about interest rates, taxes, or trade policy. It was about the US-Israel war on Iran.

“Right now, the cost of gas, the cost of groceries, it all really goes back to this war in Iran,” the progressive Democrat said on Wednesday.

“We need a War Powers Resolution rather than a senator who wants to stand hip-to-hip with Donald Trump on this war that made no sense when it started and certainly makes no sense now.”

El-Sayed was referring to legislative efforts to curb Trump’s ability to continue the eight-month conflict.

Across Michigan, Democrats are emphasising their opposition to the war to woo voters stung by rising gas and grocery prices.

“The war in Iran is a kitchen table issue,” said Jonathan Guyer, programme director at the Institute for Global Affairs (IGA).

“Voters don’t often rank foreign policy as their top issue, but I think it’s so interwoven with the economy right now that essentially foreign policy is the economy.”

IGA released a survey last month suggesting that 60 percent of potential voters disapprove of Trump’s handling of the war. More alarmingly for Republicans, an overwhelming majority of respondents – 81 percent – agreed that the conflict has raised the cost of living.

Almost immediately after Israel and the US started attacking Iran on February 28, Tehran began disrupting the flow of energy products through the Strait of Hormuz – sending oil and gas prices skyrocketing.

In the US, the price of diesel – which is used to power heavy machinery, including heavy trucks that ship consumer goods across the country – has reached record highs over the past weeks.

Likewise, petrol or gasoline has become less affordable. Average Americans feel that uptick firsthand almost daily at the gas pump.

The average price of one gallon (3.8 litres) of petrol has gone from less than $3 before the war to more than $4.27 as of Thursday, according to the American Automobile Association (AAA).

The increased cost of energy and transportation has trickled down to the entire economy, fuelling inflation at a time when affordability had become one of the key issues in US electoral politics.

Trump and his allies have argued that the war was necessary to prevent Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon.

But before the war, Trump himself had said repeatedly that Iran’s nuclear programme had been “obliterated” by the June 2025 US strikes against the country’s uranium enrichment facilities.

And US intelligence officials have testified to Congress that they have no evidence that Iran is building a nuclear bomb.

Rogers, the Michigan Senate candidate, pushed to defend the war during the debate on Wednesday.

“You want to pay $8 [for] a gallon of gas, let Iran get a nuclear weapon. You lose control of that whole region,” he said.

At the same time, Rogers has also called for an end to the conflict.

In a recent campaign commercial filmed in a grocery store, the Republican candidate said, “The war with Iran needs to end, and end quickly.”

The position is echoed by other Republicans in tough House and Senate races.

In neighbouring Ohio, Senator Jon Husted has called for a “quick” end to the war as well. In Iowa, Congresswoman Ashley Hinson, who is running for the Senate, said she told Trump that the conflict should come to an “immediate and successful end”. In Maine, Senator Susan Collins has highlighted her vote in favour of several War Powers Resolutions.

Still, Trump, who is the leader of the Republican Party, has suggested that he may renew all-out fighting with Iran after the midterm vote next month, and he has promoted the war as a historic success.

“I think it’s one of the greatest things we’ve done. We’ve stopped Iran from having a nuclear weapon,” Trump told reporters on Wednesday.

“It’s one of the best things that we’ve done, and it took a lot of courage to do it because no other president was willing to do it.”

Despite the overall unpopularity of the war, most Republicans continue to support it.

A Pew Research Center poll released earlier this month showed that 63 percent of Republican respondents said they approve of Trump’s handling of the conflict.

The IGA survey, taken in August, put the number at 74 percent. But only 34 percent of Republican respondents said they “strongly approve” of Trump’s handling of the war – down from 40 percent in April.

Guyer suggested that the lack of enthusiastic support for the war in the Republican base may hurt the party in the upcoming elections.

“It means that Republicans aren’t necessarily walking away from the president, but their support for him has a lot less conviction,” he told Al Jazeera.

“That could have implications if they actually show up to vote [and] if they are going to be involved in campaigning.”

With the elections less than two weeks away, it’s apparent that the Democrats see the war as an Achilles heel for Republicans, and they are invoking the conflict incessantly to undermine Trump-backed candidates all over the country.

At a Senate debate watch party attended by dozens of El-Sayed’s supporters in Detroit on Wednesday, Al Jazeera asked Democratic Senator Chris Murphy – who recently returned from a visit to the Middle East – about the war. His answer was all about the US economy, not the geopolitics of the region.

“Well, diesel prices here in Detroit are already above $6 a gallon, and they’re going to go higher if this war restarts. Mike Rogers just said in the debate that he’s going to support the war, which is basically a death sentence for the American economy,” Murphy told Al Jazeera.

“There’s a big choice for Michigan voters to make here. If you want this war to continue for another year, if you want gas prices to climb to $8 a gallon, vote for Mike Rogers. If you want the war to end, if you want prices to come down, then vote for Abdul El-Sayed.”
news.content:
دموکرات ها این درگیری را به عنوان یک موضوع مقرون به صرفه برای انتقاد از نامزدهای جمهوری خواه مورد حمایت ترامپ تعریف می کنند. دیترویت، میشیگان - اولین سوال در مناظره سنای ایالات متحده در میشیگان بین عبدالالسید نامزد دموکرات و رقیب جمهوری خواه او مایک راجرز در مورد موضوعی بود که به نظر می رسد برای رای دهندگان بیشترین اهمیت را دارد - اقتصاد. السید به سرعت بین خود و راجرز که مورد حمایت دونالد ترامپ رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده است، تضاد ایجاد کرد. این در مورد نرخ بهره، مالیات یا سیاست تجاری نبود. این در مورد جنگ ایالات متحده و اسرائیل علیه ایران بود. دموکرات مترقی روز چهارشنبه گفت: «در حال حاضر، هزینه گاز، هزینه خواربار، همه چیز واقعاً به این جنگ در ایران برمی گردد. ما به یک قطعنامه اختیارات جنگی نیاز داریم تا سناتوری که بخواهد با دونالد ترامپ در این جنگ که در زمان شروع آن هیچ معنایی نداشت و مطمئناً اکنون نیز بی‌معنی است، کنار بیاید.»
اشاره السید به تلاش های قانونی برای محدود کردن توانایی ترامپ برای ادامه درگیری هشت ماهه بود. دموکرات ها در سراسر میشیگان بر مخالفت خود با جنگ برای جلب نظر رای دهندگانی که به دلیل افزایش قیمت بنزین و خواربار فروشی آسیب دیده اند، تاکید می کنند. جاناتان گویر، مدیر برنامه در موسسه امور جهانی (IGA) گفت: «جنگ در ایران یک موضوع میز آشپزخانه است. رأی دهندگان اغلب سیاست خارجی را به عنوان موضوع اصلی خود رتبه بندی نمی کنند، اما من فکر می کنم در حال حاضر آنقدر با اقتصاد در هم آمیخته است که اساساً سیاست خارجی اقتصاد است.»
IGA ماه گذشته نظرسنجی را منتشر کرد که نشان می‌داد 60 درصد از رای‌دهندگان بالقوه مردد هستند

(Photo by J. David Ake/Getty Images)

As Nashville, Tennessee’s luxury housing market booms, middle-class residents are suffering from high housing costs and struggling to purchase homes.

Attracted by the lack of income and inheritance taxes, the ultra-wealthy have quickly moved to Nashville, and its luxury housing market is thriving, Bloomberg reported. Vying for homes in the Volunteer State, these elites are driving up prices and leaving longtime middle-class residents to deal with a high cost of living.

The median age of a first-time homebuyer in the United States is now 40 years old, and Nashville is no different, according to Greater Nashville Realtors. While Nashville’s policymakers have expanded efforts to improve affordability, the jury is out on whether new changes will help the city’s middle class become homeowners.

The prices of homes in Nashville have more than doubled since 2014, and baby boomer-aged people residing without children own 25% of family-sized homes in Nashville, according to Axios Nashville. Despite making up only 20% of the population, baby boomers hold over 50% of the household wealth in the United States, giving them an advantage over younger people when purchasing homes.

While sales of Nashville homes valued under $1 million declined since 2025, those valued over $2 million sold 6% more, according to Axios.

“I know a property that sold in 2021 for $6 million. In 2026, it closed for over $18 million — and if they did any work, it wasn’t much,” luxury real estate agent Jamie Parson told Bloomberg.

Nashville has experienced a greater increase in sales of homes in the top 1% by price (or ultra-luxury homes) than any other metropolitan area, a 208% increase from 2017 to 2025, Bloomberg reported. Compare this to New York City, which has seen ultra-luxury home sales decrease by 39%. Parsons marketed a $33.5 million penthouse in downtown Nashville that attracted interest spanning all the way to Dubai, she told Bloomberg.

Average-income families are priced out of most of the newly developed housing. Nashville residents require an income of $128,119 per year to afford a median-priced home, according to Redfin analysis.

Democrat Mayor Freddie O’Connell has emphasized the city’s efforts to improve affordability, and the Metro Council recently voted to pass the largest affordable housing investment in Nashville’s history, Fox 17 Nashville reported. The measure included a $40 million grant to build and rehabilitate 1,100 homes for residents making under $93,000 a year.

O’Connell didn’t respond to the Daily Caller News Foundation’s request for comment. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: Here’s How Medicaid Is Actually Impacting US Healthcare Affordability)

The grant is managed through the Barnes Housing Trust Fund, which has invested $191 million into 39 nonprofits since its inception in 2013. The Barnes Fund is credited with the preservation and creation of over 6,000 homes in the Nashville area.

Most of these homes are for renters, however. Of the 6,563 homes that have benefited from public funding, 5,131 are designated as rental homes, according to the 2026 Barnes Housing Trust Fund Annual Report. Furthermore, the affordable housing initiative has created only 467 new for-sale homes since 2013.

To receive housing vouchers in Nashville, a household must be designated “very low-income” by Nashville’s Metropolitan Development and Housing Agency (MDHA). For example, a family of four would need to earn less than $58,000 a year in 2026 to qualify for government housing assistance.

The housing affordability crisis has transformed into an issue affecting more than just the working class, and more cities than just Nashville.

“45% of the 390 metropolitan statistical areas are so expensive that households require six-figure incomes to buy an average-priced home,” Valerie White, head of National Housing Strategic Initiatives, wrote. This trend has grown beyond California and other coastal locations like New York City that are typically associated with high housing costs. Now even Nashville, Asheville, Houston and Boise are among the many cities requiring well-over six-figure incomes to afford a home.

“It has become kind of exclusive to live here now. Money is power and the rich pay whatever they need to. And if you don’t have money, you don’t have a voice,” local Nashvillian reverend Kevin Riggs told Bloomberg.

بلومبرگ گزارش داد که با رونق بازار مسکن لوکس نشویل، تنسی، ساکنان طبقه متوسط از هزینه های بالای مسکن رنج می برند و برای خرید خانه با مشکل مواجه هستند. بلومبرگ گزارش داد که به دلیل کمبود مالیات بر درآمد و ارث، افراد فوق ثروتمند به سرعت به نشویل نقل مکان کرده اند و بازار مسکن لوکس آن در حال رونق است. این نخبگان با رقابت برای خانه‌ها در ایالت داوطلب، قیمت‌ها را بالا می‌برند و ساکنان قدیمی طبقه متوسط ​​را مجبور می‌کنند تا با هزینه‌های بالای زندگی دست و پنجه نرم کنند. به گفته Realtors Greater Nashville، میانگین سنی یک خریدار خانه برای اولین بار در ایالات متحده اکنون 40 سال است و نشویل تفاوتی ندارد. در حالی که سیاست‌گذاران نشویل تلاش‌های خود را برای بهبود مقرون‌به‌صرفه گسترش داده‌اند، هیئت منصفه در مورد اینکه آیا تغییرات جدید به طبقه متوسط ​​شهر کمک می‌کند تا صاحب خانه شوند یا خیر، بررسی نشده است. قیمت خانه‌ها در نشویل از سال 2014 بیش از دو برابر شده است، و طبق گفته‌های آکسیوشویل، افرادی که در سنین کودکی هستند که بدون فرزند زندگی می‌کنند، مالک 25 درصد خانه‌های خانوادگی در نشویل هستند. علیرغم اینکه فقط 20 درصد جمعیت را تشکیل می‌دهند، بچه‌های بوم بیش از 50 درصد از ثروت خانوار در ایالات متحده را در اختیار دارند و به آنها امتیازی نسبت به افراد جوان در هنگام خرید خانه می‌دهد. در حالی که فروش خانه‌های نشویل به ارزش کمتر از 1 میلیون دلار از سال 2025 کاهش یافته است، آن‌هایی که بیش از 2 میلیون دلار ارزش دارند، 6 درصد بیشتر فروخته می‌شوند. در سال 2026، با بیش از 18 میلیون دلار بسته شد - و اگر آنها کاری انجام دادند، کار زیادی نبود.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)

A major elections forecaster shifted 19 House races in the Democrats’ favor Friday, including Republican-held seats.

The nonpartisan Cook Political Report shifted some races from “Lean Republican” to a “Toss Up” and others from “Solid Republican” to “Likely Republican.” Several “Toss Up” races in Arizona, Colorado, North Carolina, Virginia and Wisconsin were shifted to “Lean Democratic.”

Democrats are now favored to win 220 seats, while Republicans are favored in 198 seats and the remaining 17 are toss-ups, according to Cook Political Report. (RELATED: Major Election Forecaster Shifts Kansas Senate Race To Toss Up For Seat Dems Haven’t Held Since FDR)

Today, The Cook Political Report is moving 19 more House races, all in Democrats’ direction. Six districts are moving from the Toss Up column to Lean Democrat. Two more open seats are moving from Lean Republican to Toss Up. Read more from @ercovey: https://t.co/Dd0K4TFaXB

Republican Colorado Rep. Lauren Boebert’s seat — which President Donald Trump carried by 18 percentage points in 2024 — shifted from “Solid Republican” to “Lean Republican” while Republican Arizona Rep. Eli Crane’s seat — which Trump won by 15 points — shifted from “Likely Republican” to “Lean Republican.” Boebert faces a competitive reelection bid against Democratic Colorado congressional candidate Eileen Laubacher in Colorado’s heavily Republican Fourth District, where Boebert holds a 51% negative approval rating.

Toss up races in Arizona’s Sixth District and Texas’ 34th District shifted to “Lean Democratic.” Those seats are held by Republican Arizona Rep. Juan Ciscomani and Democratic Texas Rep. Vicente Gonzalez Jr. Republican Virginia Rep. Jen Kiggans’ race also leans Democratic.

The seats were Republican Reps. Gabe Evans of Colorado and Derrick Van Orden of Wisconsin are seeking reelection are also leaning Democratic.

The race to oust Democratic Texas Rep. Henry Cuellar in Texas’ 28th district shifted to “Likely Democratic.” The Congressional Leadership Fund, the top House super PAC, canceled approximately $3 million in planned advertisement spending against Cuellar while the incumbent congressman held a 20-point lead in the polls.

Republicans redrew Cuellar’s district in their 2025 round of redistricting to make it more favorable to Republicans. Trump won the redrawn district by ten percentage points in the 2024 election.

Two races in California’s 13th and 21st districts shifted to “Solid Democratic” and “Likely Democratic.”

Kentucky’s Sixth District and Texas’ 35th District — two open seats — leaned toward Republicans, but were considered toss ups as of Friday. Republicans redrew Texas’ 35th district in August to no longer include Austin or blue areas around the capital city. Despite the redistricting efforts, the race is considered a toss up between Republican Texas congressional candidate Carlos De La Cruz and Democratic Texas congressional candidate Johnny Garcia.

The GOP-linked Congressional Leadership Fund slashed $6 million in planned advertising to oppose Democratic Florida Rep. Jared Moskowitz in Florida’s 25th District, who is running for a third term in Congress against former Republican Boca Raton Mayor Scott Singer. The super PAC is redirecting $9 million to six Republican-held seats, including Kiggans’ and Ciscomani’s seats.

Republican Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis in the spring unveiled a redrawn congressional map intended to help Republicans gain four seats in the Sunshine State, including Moskowitz’s district. MAGA Inc., a Trump-aligned PAC, poured $25 million into House races Thursday, including Florida’s 25th District.

یک پیش‌بینی‌کننده اصلی انتخابات روز جمعه ۱۹ رقابت مجلس نمایندگان را به نفع دموکرات‌ها تغییر داد، از جمله کرسی‌های جمهوری‌خواه. گزارش سیاسی غیرحزبی کوک برخی از رقابت‌ها را از «جمهوری‌خواه ناب» به «پرتاب» و برخی دیگر را از «جمهوری‌خواه محکم» به «احتمالاً جمهوری‌خواه» تغییر داد. چندین مسابقه "Toss Up" در آریزونا، کلرادو، کارولینای شمالی، ویرجینیا و ویسکانسین به "دموکراتیک ناب" منتقل شدند. بر اساس گزارش سیاسی کوک، اکنون دموکرات‌ها برای کسب 220 کرسی، در حالی که جمهوری‌خواهان در 198 کرسی و 17 کرسی باقی مانده به‌دست می‌آیند، مورد حمایت قرار گرفته‌اند. (مرتبط: پیش‌بینی‌کننده اصلی انتخابات، رقابت سنای کانزاس را برای دستیابی به کرسی تغییر می‌دهد، دموکرات‌ها از زمان FDR برگزار نشده‌اند)
امروز، گزارش سیاسی کوک 19 رقابت دیگر مجلس نمایندگان را به حرکت در می‌آورد که همگی در جهت دموکرات‌ها هستند. شش منطقه از ستون Toss Up به سمت دموکرات ناب حرکت می کنند. دو کرسی آزاد دیگر از جمهوری خواه ناب به سمت پرتاب می روند. از @ercovey بیشتر بخوانید: https://t.co/Dd0K4TFaXB
کرسی لورن بوبرت، نماینده جمهوریخواه کلرادو - که دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا در سال 2024 با 18 درصد تصاحب آن را تصاحب کرد - از "جمهوری خواه یکپارچه" به "جمهوری خواه ناب" تغییر کرد در حالی که کرسی الی کرین، نماینده جمهوری خواه آریزونا - که ترامپ با 15 امتیاز برنده شد - از "جمهوری خواه احتمالی" به "جمهوری خواه احتمالی" تغییر کرد. بوبرت با یک رقابت رقابتی برای انتخاب مجدد در برابر ایلین لاباچر، نامزد دموکرات کنگره کلرادو در ناحیه چهارم به شدت جمهوری خواه کلرادو روبرو می شود، جایی که بوبرت دارای 51 درصد محبوبیت منفی است.

news.originalContent:
Manchester United make worst start to a season in 40 years, but Michael Carrick ‘confident’ ahead of Bournemouth game.

Manchester United manager Michael Carrick mounted an impassioned defence of ⁠⁠his leadership on Friday, accepting responsibility ⁠⁠for the club’s collapse in form and saying he remains convinced he can lead the team out of their current crisis.

Carrick’s position is under increasing pressure after United extended their winless run to seven matches in all competitions with Wednesday’s humiliating 4-1 ⁠⁠Champions League defeat at Como leaving them 20th in the table with three points.

Before taking questions ahead of Sunday’s Premier League home game against Bournemouth, Carrick delivered an emotional opening statement, acknowledging supporters’ frustrations and the scale of the challenge facing him.

“Recently, we haven’t had a good time. I think that’s ⁠⁠pretty obvious. So I totally accept what we’re going through at the moment,” he said.

“We had five months of relative success [last season] in a spell where I was happy with a lot of things I was seeing and that we were doing as a team,” he said.

“We haven’t done well enough lately. We’ve had a spell that we’re really not happy with.”

Carrick described the loss in Italy as one of the most painful nights of his tenure.

“Wednesday was a bad ‌‌night. It was a bad night for a lot of reasons. It hurt a lot,” he said. “It obviously hurt me to see us play that way. As I said after the game, it was really unacceptable.”

The defeat intensified scrutiny of Carrick after captain Bruno Fernandes appeared to question United’s tactical approach in his post-match comments.

Asked whether public criticism from players suggested cracks within the dressing room, Carrick rejected any suggestion the squad was split.

He also sidestepped questions over Fernandes’ future as captain and declined to reveal whether he had held talks with the Portugal midfielder following the defeat.

Instead, he stressed that his priority was restoring an identity that has disappeared from the side in recent weeks.

“My responsibility is to ⁠⁠get a team on the pitch that represents this football club, represents the supporters and they can be proud ⁠⁠of it with the identity that we show,” Carrick said.

“We have gone away from that just recently in certain games, which I’m fully aware of and definitely doing something about.”

He reserved special mention for United’s fans, many of whom travelled to Como only to watch their side suffer the heaviest defeat of his reign.

“The supporters are a huge part of this ⁠⁠football club. They have to make the effort and the time and money they spend, to feel how we all felt on Wednesday was a tough moment,” he said.

Despite growing speculation about his future, Carrick struck a ⁠⁠defiant tone, saying he remained confident United could rediscover the energy and connection that characterised ⁠⁠last season’s performances.

He took over in January 2026 after the sacking of Ruben Amorim and oversaw a remarkable turnaround, steering United to a top-three finish and Champions League qualification.

“For [the fans] to feel like they felt for five months at the start of the year … is something we need to get back to. We will get back to it. I fully believe that,” said ‌‌Carrick.

Former Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea manager Antonio Conte is among the names linked with United’s managerial job, although the 57-year-old Italian said on Friday he had not had any negotiations “at an advanced stage” with any club.

Carrick acknowledged that United had lost their way but said responsibility rested squarely with him.

He ended ‌‌his ‌‌opening remarks by saying it was his duty to get the club back on course, describing his role as “holding the umbrella for me to get wet and everyone else to stay dry”.

United are 13th in the Premier League standings on seven points, while Bournemouth are a point behind them in 15th.
news.content:
منچستریونایتد بدترین شروع یک فصل در 40 سال اخیر را داشت، اما مایکل کریک قبل از بازی بورنموث "با اعتماد به نفس" بود. مایکل کریک، سرمربی منچستریونایتد روز جمعه از رهبری خود دفاع پرشور کرد و مسئولیت سقوط باشگاه در فرم را پذیرفت و گفت که می‌تواند تیم را فریبکار کند. موقعیت کریک تحت فشار فزاینده‌ای قرار دارد، پس از اینکه یونایتد با شکست تحقیرآمیز 4-1 چهارشنبه در لیگ قهرمانان در کومو، روند بدون برد خود را به 7 بازی در تمامی رقابت‌ها افزایش داد و آنها را با سه امتیاز در رده بیستم جدول قرار داد. کریک قبل از پاسخ به سوالات قبل از بازی خانگی یکشنبه لیگ برتر مقابل بورنموث، یک بیانیه آغازین احساسی ارائه کرد، و از ناامیدی هواداران و میزان چالش پیش روی او قدردانی کرد. او گفت: "ما پنج ماه موفقیت نسبی [فصل گذشته] در دوره ای داشتیم که در آن از چیزهای زیادی راضی بودم که می دیدم و به عنوان یک تیم انجام می دادیم."
کریک باخت در ایتالیا را یکی از دردناک ترین شب های دوران تصدی خود توصیف کرد. او گفت: "چهارشنبه شب بدی بود. به دلایل زیادی شب بدی بود. خیلی دردناک بود." "بدیهی است که دیدن اینگونه بازی ما به من آسیب زد. همانطور که بعد از بازی گفتم، واقعاً غیرقابل قبول بود.

news.originalContent:
Polls show leftist incumbent Lula closing gap on right-wing rival Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of second round of voting.

Voters in Brazil are headed to the polls for the second time in one month, as Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva square off in a run-off election to decide who will hold the presidency for the next four years.

While Bolsonaro outperformed expectations during the first round of voting on October 4, when he beat Lula by less than two percentage points but failed to secure the majority needed to avoid a run-off, the leftist president has sought to rally supporters ahead of the second round.

The vote on Sunday will decide whether Brazil joins a growing list of countries across Latin America that have handed victories to far-right candidates promising closer ties with the United States, a hard hand on crime and insecurity, and market-friendly economic policies.

Brazil under Lula has emerged as a key holdout against that shift, and a Bolsonaro victory on Sunday would galvanise conservatives in the region seeking to extend their winning streak to the largest country in Latin America.

The run-off will take place on October 25, 2026.

The first round on October 4 saw Bolsonaro win 47 percent of the vote compared with just more than 45 percent for Lula, with the remainder of the votes distributed among several largely conservative candidates who did not advance to the next round.

While most polls had anticipated a close race that would go to a run-off, Lula had been slightly favoured to win the first round of voting. While Bolsonaro’s margin of victory was small, his overperformance indicated a level of enduring appeal for the political right that caught many Lula supporters off guard.

In addition to Bolsonaro’s success, even as his father, former far-right President Jair Bolsonaro, serves a 27-year prison sentence for his involvement in a coup plot following his loss to Lula in 2022, right-wing candidates also racked up wins in legislative races across the country.

Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, simply referred to as Lula, is the incumbent president and the candidate for the Workers Party, or PT.

His time in office has been defined by an effort to pair political democracy with material improvement for the country’s poor and efforts to build ties between developing, non-Western countries on the global stage.

The 80-year-old is seeking his fourth, non-consecutive term, hoping that his record of popularity and support for social programmes, credited by supporters with transforming the country, will help stave off a Bolsonaro win.

Lula clinched a third term in 2022, marking a dramatic comeback following a stint in prison based on corruption charges that were later overturned following revelations of prosecutorial impropriety.

But a highly polarised political landscape has hindered Lula’s ability to usher in ambitious and sweeping reforms during his third term.

Notable successes, such as sharp drops in unemployment and poverty and tackling deforestation in the Amazon rainforest, have been countered by rising household indebtedness that has strained families across the country.

A corruption scandal centring on disgraced banker Daniel Vorcaro has also implicated powerful figures and institutions across the political spectrum, including Bolsonaro himself as well as several members of the country’s Supreme Court, a target of right-wing ire for the conviction and sentencing of the elder Bolsonaro.

Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is running as the candidate of the right-wing Liberal Party.

The 45-year-old has emerged as the de facto leader of the country’s political right, filling a role previously held by his father before his conviction for a plot to remain in power despite his loss to Lula in 2022.

The younger Bolsonaro has sought to project a more polished image than his father while pledging continuity with many of his beliefs and policy priorities and promising to fight for his release from prison if elected.

He has pledged a militarised approach towards crime and insecurity posed by organised gangs in close partnership with the administration of United States President Donald Trump, who has sought to expand US military involvement across Latin America through ties with right-wing allies in the name of combatting crime.

Bolsonaro has also promised to rein in inflation and government spending, with an adviser stating that he would implement a debt ceiling if elected.

In the days after the first round, Bolsonaro has said he would “redemocratise” Brazil by reforming the constitution. The constitution was put in place after Brazil’s return to democracy in the 1980s, and Bolsonaro’s father has long expressed open nostalgia for the dictatorship period. There’s heavy speculation that Bolsonaro could be seeking to reform the judiciary, after his father’s legal setbacks. He has also promised to restore tax cuts for the events sector.

While many members of the PT were despondent following Bolsonaro’s first-round victory, Lula quickly urged his supporters to rally for the run-off and threw himself into campaigning.

He has also taken credit for his party’s long-sought constitutional amendment to reduce the six-day work week and promised free public transport on weekends.

Pro-Lula demonstrations in cities across the country have attracted millions of people, helping galvanise the president’s voters and cut into Bolsonaro’s lead. Bolsonaro has held his own rallies, hoping to capitalise on momentum and consolidate support from other conservative parties.

The two candidates held a combative debate on October 18, exchanging insults and accusing each other of corruption.

Questions of outside intervention have also been a theme in the campaign’s closing days, with US social media giant Meta facing allegations that it restricted pro-Lula activity online in a bid to support Bolsonaro.

Concerns about foreign interference, in particular from the US, have loomed over the campaign since the beginning.

The Trump administration has repeatedly sought to intervene in Brazilian politics, previously introducing steep tariffs and penalties against judicial officials in a bid to have the case against the elder Bolsonaro tossed out and mirroring rhetoric on the Brazilian right to cast doubt on the reliability of the country’s voting system.

Trump has himself used false claims of widespread fraud to ignore unfavourable election results, and observers have expressed concern that the US could throw its support behind Bolsonaro based on such claims even if he were to lose the race.

After his victory in the first round, Bolsonaro emerged as the race’s de facto frontrunner. But polls continue to show a close race, with Lula cutting into Bolsonaro’s lead but continuing to trail within the margin of error.

Speculation that Bolsonaro might pull ahead decisively following the first round, after other conservative candidates failed to advance to the run-off, has not yet appeared in new polls.

A Nexus poll released on Monday showed Bolsonaro winning 46.5 percent of the vote in the second round, with Lula taking 45.9 percent. A poll from the previous week had shown Bolsonaro with 47.9 percent and Lula with 45.1 percent.

Another poll by AtlasIntel and Bloomberg, also released on Monday, showed Bolsonaro with 49.8 percent versus 47.6 percent for Lula. An October 9 poll had shown Bolsonaro with 51.1 percent and Lula with 45.7.

A Quaest poll released on October 21 showed Bolsonaro’s lead continuing to drop, with Lula winning 44 percent and Bolsonaro 45 percent.

news.originalContent:
منبع تصویر، AFP via Getty Images

در پی تیراندازی در یکی از محله‌های حومه‌ پاریس، یک نفر کشته و دست‌کم چهار تن دیگر زخمی شده‌اند.

سباستین لکورنو، نخست‌وزیر فرانسه، در شبکه‌های اجتماعی نوشت که این تیراندازی در منطقه تراپ (Trappes) در غرب پاریس رخ داده و آن را یک حادثه «بسیار جدی» توصیف کرد.

او افزود که مظنون این حمله دستگیر شده و در بازداشت پلیس است.

به گزارش خبرگزاری فرانسه، یک منبع پلیس گفت که روز جمعه ۲۳ اکتبر (اول آبان) مردی از داخل یک خودرو اقدام به تیراندازی کرده و ساعاتی بعد، حوالی ساعت ۱۰:۳۰ صبح به وقت محلی، در شهری نزدیک محل حادثه دستگیر شده است.

رسانه‌های فرانسه از احتمال افزایش شمار مجروحان گزارش می‌دهند. یک رسانه محلی گزارش کرده که یکی از مجروحان یک کودک ۱۲ ساله است که مورد اصابت هشت گلوله قرار گرفته است.

علی رابح، شهردار تراپ نیز در شبکه‌های اجتماعی نوشت که صبح جمعه «فردی از داخل یک خودرو به سمت چندین نفر تیراندازی کرد.»

آقای رابح به یک رسانه محلی گفت که فرد مسلح «بی‌هدف» در چندین محله «تردد» می‌کرد و «بدون هدف شلیک می‌کرد.»

به گفته آقای رابح، ظاهرا هدف فرد مهاجم این بوده که «تا حد امکان تلفات بیشتری ایجاد کند.»

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

شهردار تراپ همچنین گفت که در جریان این تیراندازی، یک مرکز درمانی، یک پمپ‌بنزین و چندین خودرو هدف اصابت گلوله قرار گرفته‌اند.

یک مقام پلیس محلی گفت که فرد مظنون از «یک سلاح نیمه‌خودکار قدیمی» استفاده کرده و به صورت رگباری تیراندازی کرده است.

روزنامه لو پاریزین گزارش می‌دهد که قدمت این سلاح به دوران جنگ جهانی دوم بازمی‌گردد.

رابه اظهار داشت که تیرانداز در جریان این اقدامات، به یک مرکز درمانی، یک پمپ‌بنزین و چندین خودرو شلیک کرده است.

دفتر ملی دادستانی ضدتروریسم فرانسه اعلام کرد که رسیدگی به این حادثه را بر عهده گرفته است. به گفته این نهاد، به نظر می‌رسد این حادثه «قتل در ارتباط با یک اقدام تروریستی» باشد. این نهاد همچنین می‌گوید که تحقیقاتش شامل مواردی همچون «در اختیار داشتن سلاح رده آ» و «تبانی با یک گروه تروریستی به منظور اقدام به جنایت علیه اشخاص» می‌شود.

به گفته نخست‌وزیر فرانسه، دفتر دادستانی ملی ضدتروریسم اعلام کرده است که وضعیت را تحت نظارت دارد و «تمام منابع نیروهای امنیتی و دستگاه قضایی به محل اعزام شده‌اند.»

لوران نونز، وزیر کشور فرانسه، در مسیر سفر به محل حادثه، گفت که این حادثه «شبیه به یک یورش مرگبار» به نظر می‌رسد. او با این حال تاکید کرد که انگیزه مهاجم تا این لحظه مشخص نیست.

به گزارش رسانه‌های محلی، فرد مظنون که ۳۹ سال دارد، برای پلیس شناخته‌شده بود، اما نام او در سوابق سرویس‌های اطلاعاتی فرانسه وجود نداشت.

نیکولا دنویل، شهردار لا وری‌یر، فرد مظنون را «دارای ظاهری اروپایی» توصیف کرد.

امانوئل مکرون، رئیس‌جمهور فرانسه، ضمن ابراز «تأثر عمیق» و همدردی با قربانیان، افزود: «در این مصیبت هولناک، مردم فرانسه در کنار آنها ایستاده است.»

این تیراندازی در حالی رخ می‌دهد که فرانسه شاهد تنش‌های زیادی است.

این کشور اخیرا شاهد اعتراضات سراسری و صحنه‌های خشونت بار درگیری معترضان با نیروهای پلیس بوده است.

مقام‌های فرانسه اعلام کردند که از زمان شروع ناآرامی‌ها، بیش از ۲۵۰۰ نفر بازداشت شده‌اند. دست یکی از معترضان هم با نارنجک کنترل جمعیت پلیس قطع شد.

حدود ۱۰۰۰ مامور پلیس هم زخمی شدند.

طی این ناآرامی‌ها، فروشگاه‌ها هم غارت شدند و برآورد می‌شود که حدود ۱۵۰۰ مغازه و کسب‌وکار غارت و تخریب شده‌اند.

اعتراض‌ها ابتدا در ماه گذشته میلادی با درخواست دانش‌آموزان برای بهبود شرایط مدارس آغاز شد، اما با افزایش شمار شرکت‌کنندگان در تظاهرات و مشارکت اتحادیه‌های کارگری و گروه‌های مختلف اعتراضی، دامنه وسیع‌تری از درخواست‌ها را در بر گرفت.

news.originalContent:
Ex-Chelsea boss Antonio Conte denies Manchester United link, says reports he demanded full control of club ‘unfounded’.

Former Chelsea and Napoli coach Antonio Conte said he was not in advanced negotiations to replace Manchester United manager Michael Carrick, and called reports that he had demanded full control at the club “unfounded”.

Conte, who won the Premier League with Chelsea and also managed Tottenham Hotspur in England, was responding to speculation that he had requested full control while also making financial demands of the struggling Old Trafford club.

United sit 13th in the Premier League and 20th in the Champions League standings following Wednesday’s humiliating 4-1 thrashing by Italian side Como, increasing scrutiny on Carrick.

“My name has been linked with numerous clubs, but there are currently no negotiations at an advanced stage,” Conte said in a statement.

“Following a wonderful and successful spell in charge of Napoli, I will take the time I need to consider how and when to return to management,” he added, referring to his time in Naples where he won Serie A in the 2024-25 season.

“It will be a carefully considered decision, one I will make when I believe the conditions are right.

“I have read reports of financial demands and requests for full control that I have supposedly already made to the clubs mentioned, as well as reservations about what has been described as my ‘strong personality’.

“These reports are unfounded, as there is currently no concrete basis for such assessments.”

Conte, who last coached Napoli in the 2025-26 season, said that if a concrete opportunity arose, he would enter talks with the club involved and “jointly consider the terms of a potential agreement”, taking into account the needs of both parties.

“Until then, any assumptions about my demands and my professional future remain speculation and cannot be treated as fact,” the 57-year-old Italian added.

In an interview with The Athletic earlier this month, Conte said he would like to manage a club that has “lost sight of their history” so he can help “make it shine once more”.

Defeat against Como extended United’s winless run to seven games in all competitions, and skipper Bruno Fernandes said his team had adopted a “mood of defeat” while also questioning the tactics, with Carrick apologising for the performance.

Brighton and Hove Albion manager Fabian Hurzeler, another name linked with the United job, also distanced himself from the speculation on Friday.

The 33-year-old, England’s youngest top-flight manager, said he was focused solely on Brighton, who sit third in the Premier League after a string of impressive performances.

“I have no time to think about these rumours because we play every three days and, beside that, I have a lot of respect for Michael Carrick and what he has done with Manchester United the last season,” Hurzeler told a news conference.

“He’s a great human being, a great personality. There’s nothing more to say about that.”

Brighton’s free-scoring start to the Premier League season has seen Hurzeler touted as a possible successor should United make a mid-season managerial change for the third consecutive campaign.

The Seagulls sit third in the table, behind only Manchester City and champions Arsenal, before Sunday’s trip to Liverpool.

“I am really focused on my job here. I have no time to think about these rumours because we play every three days,” said the 33-year-old German.

Brighton’s scoring streak came to an end in a 0-0 draw at Czech side Jablonec in the Europa League on Thursday.

Despite an excellent start to the campaign, which also includes coming from 2-0 down to beat United 3-2 at Old Trafford in the League Cup last month, Hurzeler believes his side can still improve.

“There is still improvements we can do, still a lot of potential to get out of the players, and therefore I really want to work on that together with my players, together with my staff,” he said.

“I have great experts around me. I have a great group of players who support me, who give everything for this club, and we built this over the last years.

“We had tough periods, we have good periods, but I think to build these kind of relationships, you need time, you need connections, and you don’t take these things for granted.”
news.content: آنتونیو کونته، سرمربی سابق چلسی، ارتباط منچستریونایتد را تکذیب کرد و می‌گوید گزارش‌هایی که او خواستار کنترل کامل باشگاه شده است "بی اساس" است. آنتونیو کونته، سرمربی سابق چلسی و ناپولی گفت که در حال مذاکره پیشرفته برای جایگزینی مایکل کریک، سرمربی منچستریونایتد نیست و گزارش‌ها مبنی بر اینکه او خواستار کنترل کامل باشگاه شده است را "بی اساس" خواند. کونته که با چلسی قهرمان لیگ برتر شد و همچنین هدایت تاتنهام هاتسپر در انگلیس را برعهده داشت، در پاسخ به این گمانه زنی ها مبنی بر اینکه درخواست کنترل کامل داشته و در عین حال مطالبات مالی را از باشگاه در حال مبارزه اولدترافورد مطرح کرده است. یونایتد در رده سیزدهم لیگ برتر و بیستم در جدول رده بندی لیگ قهرمانان اروپا پس از شکست تحقیرآمیز روز چهارشنبه با برتری 4-1 تیم ایتالیایی در مقابل تیم کوکروت ایتالیا قرار دارد. کونته در بیانیه‌ای گفت: «نام من با باشگاه‌های متعددی مرتبط شده است، اما در حال حاضر هیچ مذاکره‌ای در مرحله پیشرفته وجود ندارد.» او با اشاره به دوران حضورش در ناپل، جایی که در فصل 2024-2025 سری آ را برد، افزود: «پس از یک دوره فوق‌العاده و موفقیت‌آمیز هدایت ناپولی، زمان لازم را برای بررسی چگونگی و زمان بازگشت به مدیریت اختصاص خواهم داد. این تصمیمی است که با دقت بررسی شده است، تصمیمی را زمانی اتخاذ خواهم کرد که معتقدم شرایط مساعد باشد.» گزارش‌هایی درباره درخواست‌های مالی و درخواست‌هایی برای کنترل کامل که ظاهراً قبلاً به باشگاه‌های ذکر شده ارائه کرده‌ام، و همچنین در مورد آنچه که به عنوان «شخصیت قوی» من توصیف شده است، خوانده‌ام.

Below is State of the Day, a morning newsletter from the Daily Caller Editorial Desk. Sign up here.__________

Welcome to State of the Day,

Just in case the FBI, CIA, NSA, ODNI, and the rest we don’t know about weren’t enough!

Meet The Newest Member Of The Deep State

Custom hacking tools, clandestinely planted faulty components, and covert sabotage operations — think Mission: Impossible — have quietly arrived at the Pentagon.

And, I’ll admit, at first I thought it sounded pretty awesome.

But you know what else sounded perfectly reasonable at first? Every other U.S. intelligence agency.

The unfortunate truth is when you mix large sums of undisclosed government spending with the most power-hungry among us, it’ll never end well.

The Pentagon established the Technology Support Office, or TSO, without its usual pomp and circumstance. Formed in April, the office brought together the Pentagon’s efforts to develop tools and strategies to disrupt foreign defense tech, all under one covert umbrella, according to Politico.

Their work reportedly includes everything from offensive hacking to deception operations designed to fool adversaries abroad into using faulty equipment in their weapons systems.

The idea makes sense, and most reasonable people could support the mission to keep our enemies from gaining a strategic advantage. But the Pentagon has decided the best way to do that is creating another three-letter agency, shrouded in secrecy, with God knows what budget and procurement powers.

One former senior Pentagon intelligence official estimated the office’s classified contracts budget alone could exceed $1.5 billion, though Politico noted it’s an unofficial estimate.

The pitch for these new agencies is never hard to understand: the CIA was meant to coordinate intel after WW2, the NSA was supposed to consolidate intelligence during the Cold War, and ODNI came after 9/11.

All reasonable problems worth fixing, but if you ask me, little good ever comes from the government acting in secret.

When the CIA was worried sick about Soviet mind control techniques, they used prostitutes to lure unsuspecting men into CIA safehouses and pumped them full of LSD to see if they could control their minds while agents watched behind a two-way mirror; see MK ULTRA.

See how quickly a national security pitch morphs into deep state debauchery? You’d be hard-pressed to find a throughline between WW2 and functionally lobotomizing Americans with psychedelics and high-voltage electroshock therapy.

And before you call me a conspiracy theorist, let me throw in my bit about Epstein, too.

The American intelligence community and the FBI worked to suppress evidence, documents, and implicated parties related to Jeffrey Epstein in an effort to keep the extent of the horrific sexual abuse and sex trafficking perpetuated at his behest hidden from the American public.

Would anyone care to explain how that has absolutely anything to do with the agency’s charge to “protect and defend against rampant crime?”

Oh, and don’t forget, your very own U.S. House of Representatives voted to create a brand new technology cooperation initiative with Israel in the National Defense Authorization Act, which would “expand and accelerate bilateral defense technology research, development, testing, evaluation, integration, and industrial cooperation.” I’m sure this fun little venture will offer plenty of opportunities for play date espionage.

That no doubt will end well, and surely won’t result in any catastrophic security failures!

So please, cut me some slack if I’m not jazzed by another secretive government program that spends our tax dollars doing who knows what.

We’ve seen time and time again what happens when these swampy endeavors lack any modicum of public accountability.

If I can offer any consolation, the TSO Netflix documentary will probably be a good watch.

news.originalContent:
Facilities are being built in many countries, but Finland is the first to licence its underground storage facility.

Finland has granted an operating licence for the world’s first permanent underground repository for spent nuclear fuel.

The government handed Onkalo, in western Finland, the licence on Thursday, waste management company Posiva said.

Although the move does not allow the opening of the facility, it is expected to start operations soon, the firm said. However, 22 years after construction began, no exact date has been decided yet.

“This is a great and historic day for both Posiva and Finland,” the company’s Chief Executive Officer Ilkka Poikolainen said in a statement.

“Before final disposal begins, Posiva will finalise the commissioning stage, carrying out the necessary tests and inspections which STUK [the Finnish Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority] also needs to verify and approve.”

With space for 6,500 tonnes of uranium, Onkalo, which means “cave” in Finnish, will provide permanent storage for spent fuel from Finland’s five nuclear reactors.

The fuel will be enclosed in copper canisters that are highly resistant to corrosion inside the geological repository. The canisters will then be lowered into holes drilled into the bedrock, which will be filled with bentonite clay and finally sealed with a steel-reinforced concrete plug.

The waste will remain highly radioactive for tens of thousands of years. After about 100,000 years, the levels will be about the same as the uranium ore of which the fuel is made, according to Posiva.

Countries have been wrestling with what to do with dangerous nuclear by-products since the first plants were built in the 1950s. Currently, most of it is in temporary storage.

Final repositories are being built in other countries, including neighbouring Sweden and France, but Finland is expected to be the first to open its underground storage facility.

The cost of the Onkalo site has been estimated at $1.16bn.
news.content:
تاسیسات در بسیاری از کشورها در حال ساخت هستند، اما فنلاند اولین کشوری است که مجوز تاسیسات ذخیره سازی زیرزمینی خود را صادر کرده است. شرکت مدیریت زباله Posiva گفت، فنلاند مجوز بهره برداری برای اولین مخزن دائمی زیرزمینی سوخت هسته ای مصرف شده در جهان را اعطا کرده است. شرکت مدیریت پسماند Posiva گفت که دولت روز پنجشنبه مجوز را به Onkalo در غرب فنلاند داد. به گفته این شرکت، اگرچه این حرکت اجازه افتتاح این تاسیسات را نمی دهد، انتظار می رود به زودی عملیات اجرایی آن آغاز شود. با این حال، 22 سال پس از شروع ساخت، هنوز تاریخ دقیقی تعیین نشده است. ایلکا پویکلاینن، مدیر اجرایی این شرکت، در بیانیه ای گفت: "این یک روز بزرگ و تاریخی برای هر دو Posiva و فنلاند است." قبل از شروع دفع نهایی، پوزیوا مرحله راه اندازی را نهایی می کند و آزمایش ها و بازرسی های لازم را انجام می دهد که STUK [سازمان تابش و ایمنی هسته ای فنلاند] نیز باید آن را تأیید و تأیید کند.
Onkalo که در زبان فنلاندی به معنای غار است، با فضایی برای 6500 تن اورانیوم، ذخیره دائمی سوخت مصرف شده از پنج رآکتور هسته ای فنلاند را فراهم می کند. سوخت در قوطی های مسی محصور می شود که در برابر خوردگی در داخل مخزن زمین شناسی بسیار مقاوم هستند. سپس قوطی ها در سوراخ های حفر شده در سنگ بستر فرو می روند که با خاک رس بنتونیت پر می شود و در نهایت با یک پلاگین بتونی تقویت شده با فولاد مهر و موم می شود. زباله ها برای ده ها هزار سال به شدت رادیواکتیو باقی می مانند. پس از حدود 100000 سال، سطوح در حدود t خواهد بود

آقای نتانیاهو که در بحبوحه رقابت تنگاتنگ برای دوره جدید انتخابات اسرائيل است، گفت که گام اول شامل «آواره کردن ساکنان، تفتیش خانه‌ها و نابودی زیرساخت‌های تروریستی» خواهد بود.

ارتش اسرائیل تخریب ساختمان‌های فلسطینی در شهر الخلیل را پس از کشته شدن این دو سرباز اسرائیلی در حمله دو فرد مسلح فلسطینی آغاز کرده است.

به گفته مقام‌ها، در حمله به یک ایست بازرسی در حومه الخلیل، سه سرباز اسرائیلی دیگر زخمی شدند و دو مهاجم مسلح  نیز با تیراندازی نیروهای اسرائیلی کشته شدند.

تصاویری که بی‌بی‌سی صحت آن‌ها را تایید کرده است، درگیری مسلحانه شدیدی میان سربازان اسرائیلی و افراد مسلح را در یک ایست بازرسی نظامی در ورودی شهر الخلیل در کرانه باختری اشغالی نشان می‌دهد.

آقای نتانیاهو گفت که به ارتش دستور داده است برای اعمال محدودیت‌های کامل تردد در سراسر کرانه باختری آماده شود.

او همچنین دستور داد شهر الخلیل تحت «محاصره و محدودیت‌های شدید» قرار بگیرد.

این حمله در شرایطی رخ داده است که تنش‌ها در این منطقه به‌شدت افزایش بافته است و شهرک‌نشینان یهودی افراطی در جریان فصل سالانه برداشت زیتون، فلسطینیان را هدف قرار می‌دهند.

ارتش اسرائیل اعلام کرد که مقدار زیادی مهمات در خودروی مهاجمان پیدا کرده است. به گفته ارتش، ارزیابی اولیه این است که افراد مسلح قصد داشتند «حمله‌ای بسیار گسترده‌تر» در جاده‌ای در نزدیکی محل حادثه، انجام دهند، اما پس از رسیدن به ایست بازرسی، تصمیم گرفتند به نیروهای مستقر در آن جا تیراندازی کنند.

تصاویر دوربین‌های مداربسته که صحت آن‌ها تایید نشده است، دو فرد مسلح را نشان می‌دهد که از یک خودرو پیاده می‌شوند. به نظر می‌رسد یکی از آن‌ها سلاح کمری و دیگری تفنگ در دست دارد. آن‌ها به سوی سربازان مستقر در ایست بازرسی تیراندازی می‌کنند و سپس نیروهای اسرائیلی به سوی آن‌ها شلیک می‌کنند.

ارتش اسرائیل پیش‌تر اعلام کرد عملیات یورش به خانه‌های مهاجمان را آغاز کرده است.

تخریب خانه‌های فلسطینیانی که مظنون به انجام حملات علیه اسرائیلی‌ها هستند، از اقدامات رایج نیروهای اسرائیلی به شمار می‌رود.

بتسالل اسموتریچ، وزیر دارایی راست افراطی در بیانیه‌ای اعلام کرد که انجام یک «عملیات نظامی فراگیر» در کرانه باختری برای شکست دادن «تروریست‌ها» ضروری است.

او گفت: «ضروری است تشکیلات فلسطینی برچیده شود، سلاح‌ها جمع‌آوری شوند و تروریست‌ها کشته شوند.»

بنیامین نتانیاهو که محور اصلی کارزار انتخاباتی خود را وعده تامین امنیت اسرائیلی‌ها قرار داده است، اعلام کرد حزب لیکود، به رهبری او، برنامه‌های انتخاباتی صبح جمعه را لغو کرده است.

رسانه‌های اسرائیلی پیش‌تر گزارش داده بودند که قرار است در روزهای دوشنبه و سه‌شنبه (۴ و ۵ آبان/۲۶ و ۲۷ اکتبر) هم‌زمان با برگزاری انتخابات در آن کشور محدودیت‌های رفت‌وآمد در کرانه باختری اعمال شود.

بر اساس آمار سازمان ملل متحد، از ابتدای سال جاری میلادی تاکنون دست‌کم ۹۶ فلسطینی در کرانه باختری به دست نیروهای اسرائیلی یا شهرک‌نشینان کشته شده‌اند.

سازمان ملل می‌گوید در همین مدت، چهار اسرائیلی، شامل نیروهای امنیتی و غیرنظامیان، هم  توسط فلسطینیان در این منطقه کشته شده‌اند.

news.title: ترامپ از لغو محدودیت‌های استارلینک خبر داد اما اوکراین می‌گوید همچنان برقرار است
news.originalSummary:
منابعی در وزارت دفاع اوکراین می‌گویند که اختلال در شبکه استارلینک همچنان ادامه دارد، این در حالی است که دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا پیش‌تر اعلام کرده بود که ایلان ماسک محدودیت‌های این سامانه ماهواره‌ای را لغو کرده است.

این منابع گفتند که مواردی از قطع ارتباط پهپادها هنگام حرکت با سرعت ۱۶۱ کیلومتر در ساعت ثبت شده است که عملیات نظامی اوکراین را با مشکل مواجه می‌کند.
